Overview

Agartala is a city in Tripura with a population of 500,000. The capital of Tripura, a city in northeast India known for its royal palace, Bengali culture, and scenic lakes. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
